problem_statement: In front-end-by-rimantas/18-grupe-portfolio-saas-one (the SaasOne marketing landing template), add a native 'Filter features by discipline' control to the homepage feature section that lets a visitor narrow the six JS-rendered feature cards (Branding, Photography, Analisys, Cloud Data, Customization, Customer Support) to a discipline. Render a pill row (All disciplines / Creative / Data / Support) directly above the #feature_block card grid, and a live result-count readout in the form 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>'. Clicking a pill must re-render the feature cards to the matching discipline AND update the readout count and label. Surface the same filter component on the home, about, and contact pages so the feature line-up stays consistent across the marketing site. The control must keep the exact SaasOne look -- Quicksand/Montserrat typography, lavender section pills, purple CTAs, soft white feature cards, the six feature names and icon color accents, the hero, app imagery, testimonials, team photos, footer attribution, and static HTTP behavior -- and it must lay out cleanly (no card overlap, legible text) on desktop, tablet, and mobile with no horizontal scrolling on any viewport.
required_content: Add a 'Filter features by discipline' pill row (All disciplines / Creative / Data / Support) directly above the #feature_block feature-card grid on the homepage.
Render a live result-count readout in the form 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>' that updates when a discipline pill is clicked.
Clicking a discipline pill must re-render the six feature cards down to the cards in that discipline (Creative shows 2, Data shows 2, Support shows 2, All disciplines shows 6).
Surface the same feature-discipline filter component on the home, about, and contact pages.
Keep the six original feature cards (Branding, Photography, Analisys, Cloud Data, Customization, Customer Support) with their icon color accents intact.

Preserve the original SaasOne logo, Ultimate Platform hero, app imagery, testimonial copy, team photos, footer attribution, Quicksand/Montserrat font setup, purple CTA language, and static HTTP behaviour.
Lay out the filter row and feature grid with no horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports, keeping all card text legible.
design_constraints: Keep the existing Quicksand/Montserrat typography, the lavender section-label pill color (#B374FB), purple primary buttons (#7052FB), soft white card surfaces with subtle box-shadow depth, and the rounded 5-8px corner radius component language.
Style the discipline pills as rounded 24px chips: white with a thin purple border when inactive and a solid purple fill with white text when active, matching the SaasOne button palette.

Lay the six feature cards out as an equal-height 3-column grid on desktop (2-column on tablet, single column on mobile) with a consistent 28px gap, icon color-accent circle on the left, and a dark navy (#2F2A55) heading over grey body copy.
Place the filter as a native feature-section control above the feature card grid; do not bolt on an unrelated metric-tile strip or replace the feature section.
The active discipline pill and every feature card heading and body must stay legible with strong contrast; cards must not overlap, shingle, rotate, or collide.
The pill row must reflow (wrap) on narrow viewports so the page never scrolls horizontally.
state_constraints: On the initial homepage feature state the readout reads 'Showing 6 of 6 · All disciplines' and all six feature cards are visible.
After clicking the Creative pill the readout reads 'Showing 2 of 6 · Creative' and only the two Creative cards (Branding, Photography) render.
The feature-discipline filter is present on the home, about, and contact pages.

change_completion: The homepage feature section shows a 'Filter features by discipline' pill row above the #feature_block grid with All disciplines / Creative / Data / Support options.
A live readout in the form 'Showing N of 6 · <Discipline>' reflects the active discipline, reading 'Showing 6 of 6 · All disciplines' initially.
Clicking the Creative pill re-renders the grid to the two Creative feature cards and updates the readout to 'Showing 2 of 6 · Creative'.
design_consistency: The filter uses SaasOne lavender labels, purple active pills, soft white feature cards, compact rounded radius, and the existing Quicksand/Montserrat typography.
The same feature-discipline filter component appears on the home, about, and contact pages so the marketing feature line-up is consistent across pages.
responsive: On mobile (390px) and tablet the pill row wraps and the feature grid reflows so the homepage has zero horizontal overflow.
The feature cards keep an equal-height, non-overlapping grid rhythm across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
regression: The hero, app imagery, testimonials, team photos, footer attribution, and the six feature names with icon color accents remain intact and legible.
No feature card overlaps another and no card heading or body text becomes illegible (no near-white-on-near-white text).

author_notes: Rebuilt slot_312 to a native lever on front-end-by-rimantas/18-grupe-portfolio-saas-one (SaasOne): the marketing landing page already renders six feature cards from js/data/features.js, so the natural interactive control is a 'Filter features by discipline' pill row over that feature grid with a live result-count readout, not a bolted-on metric strip. The task exercises visual design layout (soft white cards, lavender pills, purple accents, SVG logo and PNG imagery under img/, box-shadow depth, rounded radius, responsive grid reflow) plus a real filter interaction. Local assets referenced include img/logo-color-2.svg and the img/*.png marketing images.
